edits.before: Captain's Cottage is 15 minutes from Main Street. We send every guest.
edits.after: Captain's Cottage is 15 minutes from Main Street. If you're the kind of person who likes knowing where you are, it's worth an afternoon.
edits.note: Will's note: 'We don't send every guest. That sounds silly for such a small-stakes tourist attraction, that isn't really even a tourist attraction.' Rewrote to a modest, reader-addressed recommendation — low-key, no sweeping claim, no pressure. Matches Will's voice: specific, warm, never overselling.
